description: Guardrail 5: 'Never mark work as done yourself... Attempting to promote a task yourself is blocked by a hook — that block is correct, do not route around it.' Guards the enforcement mechanism rush-implement is instructed to rely on: task-status.sh must reject a done-promotion attempted by any actor other than rush-verifier.

given.scenario: Fixture feature 999-fixture with task T1 at status pending. Simulates rush-implement attempting to promote T1 to done itself after finishing the work, instead of waiting for rush-verifier.
